data.name: Aimen
data.gender_notes: Aimen is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who is trustworthy, reliable, and responsible. Derived from the Arabic word 'A'imana' which means trust or belief. The name Aimen carries the meaning “Trustworthy, Responsible” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, English. Parents who choose Aimen usually hope their child will grow to embody trustworthy, responsible and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes faith, trust, and the responsibility to uphold the trust placed in us by others.
data.etymology: Aimen belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Trustworthy, Responsible.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aimen total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
